page.purpose: The page and the top bar.

panel.purpose: The sidebar, the drawer and the quiet banner.

raised.purpose: Question blocks, the popover, the checked segment, the skip link.

code.purpose: Code blocks, empty wire panes, the plain callout.

ink-2.purpose: Captions, property names, placeholders, instructions, inactive icons.

ink-3.purpose: Disabled button labels and property glyphs only; not for live text.

hairline.purpose: Inset 1px dividers: sidebar edge, top bar, property list, builder panel.

hairline-strong.purpose: Inset outline of fields, the select, an unchecked check box.

edge-strong.purpose: The ring of the checked segment: 3:1 on the track in both schemes, so the picked state is not colour alone.

hover.purpose: Hover fill of buttons, rows and summaries; the segmented track; inline code.

bar-muted.purpose: Fill of rows that did not win, and of a stale winner.

accent.purpose: The winning row, focus outlines, the focused field ring.

accent-fill.purpose: The primary button fill; white on it reads at 4.68:1.

accent-fill-hover.purpose: The primary button on hover and active; 5.78:1 with white.

accent-tint.purpose: The 2px halo outside a focused field.

on-accent.purpose: Text and the check glyph on blue.

danger.purpose: Fault titles, icons, lines, the invalid ring, the location code, Remove question.

danger-tint.purpose: Fill of the fault callout, the fault banner, a question fault line.

danger-tint-2.purpose: Fill behind the location code inside a fault.

tooltip.purpose: The tooltip card and the toast; white in the dark scheme.

tooltip-ink.purpose: Text on the tooltip and toast.

page-title.purpose: The one Playground heading beside its 32px page glyph. The only letter-spacing on the page.

page-title-compact.purpose: The same heading below 720px, beside a 24px glyph.

block-heading.purpose: State, Questions, question ids, toggle headings.

ui.purpose: Buttons, rows, the crumb; the workspace name and the winning option name at 600.

body.purpose: Lede, instructions (65ch), option names, readouts, properties, field text, callouts (56ch); tabular numerals.

small.purpose: Segments (line-height 1), small buttons, banner, toast, question fault lines; 400 for toggle captions and field fault lines.

label.purpose: Field labels, sidebar headings, tags, tooltip, criteria legends, wire pane headings.

caption.purpose: Token count, last-run line, field notes, sidebar foot, option notes, score fit.

code.purpose: State, questions JSON, wire panes, snippet; 1.5 in a code field; inline code at 0.85em on the hover fill.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Question blocks: the ring that stands in for a border.

shadows.name: field-inset
shadows.purpose: Inputs, the select, an unchecked check box.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: A focused field, select or code block; other controls use outline: 2px solid var(--accent) at 1px offset.

shadows.name: fault-inset
shadows.purpose: A field or code block with aria-invalid="true".

shadows.name: divider
shadows.value: inset -1px 0 0 var(--hairline) | inset 0 -1px 0 var(--hairline) | inset 0 1px 0 var(--hairline)
shadows.purpose: Sidebar right edge; top bar and banner bottom; top of a property list or builder panel.

shadows.name: segment-lift
shadows.purpose: The checked segment on its raised plate.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: The share popover and the skip link.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The sidebar as a drawer below 960px.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The shell collapse, the drawer, the scrim, and the bar growth.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Hover fills, colours, box-shadows, the toggle marker turn, the collapse control fade; none under reduced motion.

motion.name: normal
motion.purpose: Sidebar collapse (grid columns), drawer slide (transform) and scrim (opacity); none under reduced motion.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: A bar fill grows from 0 to the returned probability after each run; none under reduced motion.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: The Run button spinner arc while busy; still under reduced motion.

motion.name: scroll
motion.purpose: scrollIntoView is smooth, instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: toast-hold
motion.purpose: The copy toast clears after four seconds.

breakpoints.name: page-padding
breakpoints.purpose: Page side padding drops from 48px to 32px.

breakpoints.name: drawer
breakpoints.purpose: Columns stack; the sidebar becomes a fixed drawer over a scrim; the page is inert while it is open.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Page padding 16px, title 1.5rem, bar rows restack, exchange panes stack, popover fixed under the top bar.

darkScheme.note: The same tokens are redefined under the media query; the page offers no switch. accent, accent-fill, accent-fill-hover, on-accent and selection do not change. Per-token dark values sit in colorMeta.<token>.dark.

components.name: Run (primary button)
components.description: The one blue button, in the sticky top bar. Held with aria-disabled (never disabled) at 50% opacity with its reason in the banner; busy at 85% with a turning arc and the label Running or Pulling; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter presses it from anywhere.

components.description: A native radio group in a low track; the checked option lifts onto a raised plate. Arrow keys move the choice; the invisible radio covers its segment. Used for a question type and the snippet language.

components.description: A real select dressed as a field in the sidebar: transparent with the inset hairline, a 14px chevron, hover fill, the blue focus ring; pulled models first, then library models with their download size.

components.description: A refused request as the API reported it: the alert glyph and title in danger on the danger tint, each 422 issue as its location code then its message in ink. The plain callout is the same block on the code fill with an ink-2 glyph.

narrative.overview:
The playground is a page in a workspace the developer already knows: a paper-grey sidebar of settings and pages on the left, one white page of blocks on the right, a thin sticky bar above it holding the page's name and its one blue button. Notion's app grammar is played straight, with Linear and GitHub as the craft bar: the system sans at 14px, warm ink on white, hairlines where other products draw borders, small radii, chrome that shows itself on hover, toggle blocks, callouts and property rows. The work is the blocks. The state is a code block, each question is a white block with a hairline, and every returned probability is a property with a low progress bar and its exact figure at the end of the row.

Density is product-UI density: 28px controls, 24px rows inside blocks, 12px between blocks, 32px between the sections of the page. Nothing is decorated. There is no hardware or instrument metaphor, no engraved legend, no glowing readout, no web font, no gradient. Elevation is a 1px hairline shadow or a divider; only surfaces that float (the share popover, the drawer, the toast) cast a real shadow. The page follows the system scheme and offers no switch of its own: the same tokens turn a white page into a `#191919` one.

Colour is spent on meaning. One blue marks the decision: the Run button, focus, text selection, and the winning row of an answer. Red marks a fault: the callout for a refused request, the fault banner and fault lines, an invalid field's hairline, and the one action that destroys a question. Everything else is ink at three strengths on white, paper-grey and code-grey.
keyCharacteristics: A 240px workspace sidebar beside one page of blocks, under a sticky 45px top bar with the blue Run.
The system sans and system mono only; 14px UI, 13px code, 16px block headings, one 32px page title.
Warm ink `#37352f` on white, `#fbfbfa` sidebar, `#e9e9e7` hairlines, hover fills at 8% ink.
Radii of 3, 4, 6 and 8px; a 10px tooltip is the roundest thing on the page.
Answers as property rows: a 16px check, the option name, a 6px progress bar, the exact figure.
Blue for the decision, red for the fault, grey for everything else; light and dark from one token set.

rules.name: The Blue Is a Decision Rule
rules.body: Blue appears where something was decided or is about to be: the Run fill, the focus outline, text selection, and the bar and check of the winning row. It is never a heading, a link colour, a border or a background.

rules.name: The Red Is a Fault Rule
rules.body: Red marks a refusal or a destruction, nothing else: the fault callout, the fault banner, fault lines, an invalid field's hairline, the location code of a 422 issue, and the Remove question button. Emphasis, warnings and decoration never take it.

rules.name: The Hairlines, Not Borders Rule
rules.body: Nothing draws a CSS border in the normal schemes. An edge is a 1px shadow (`rgb(15 15 15 / 0.1) 0 0 0 1px` on blocks, an inset 16% ink line on fields) or a 1px inset divider in `hairline`; forced-colors mode is the one place borders are drawn.

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: No web font is loaded and none may be added; the page renders in whatever sans and mono the platform ships. Letter-spacing is off everywhere except the -0.01em of the 32px title. Nothing is set in uppercase.

rules.name: The Figures As Returned Rule
rules.body: Probabilities print as percent with one decimal, confidence, noul, score and extras with two decimals, counts and names verbatim; every figure carries its raw value and JSON pointer in `data-value` and `data-field`. Figures are tabular and right-aligned in a 4.5rem readout column.

rules.name: The Floating Only Rule
rules.body: A block on the page never casts an offset shadow; it gets the 1px hairline ring or a divider. Offset shadows belong to surfaces that float over the page: the popover, the drawer, the toast, the skip link, and the checked segment's 1px lift.

dos: **Do** set every control at 28px (24px inside a row), 14px at 500, transparent at rest, 8% ink on hover, 16% when pressed or expanded.
**Do** use `aria-disabled="true"` on a held button, never `disabled`, so it keeps focus and its tooltip; put the reason in the banner or beside the control.
**Do** separate surfaces with hairlines: the 1px ring on blocks, the inset 16% ink line on fields, the 1px inset divider between regions.
**Do** show a returned probability as a bar row: check, name, 6px bar grown over 400ms, the exact figure tabular at the right; the winner alone in blue.
**Do** keep every figure at its stated precision with `data-field` and `data-value` attached, and grey it (not remove it) when the inputs move on.
**Do** keep hover, colour and shadow transitions at 100ms `ease-in`, the shell and drawer at 200ms, and turn every transition and animation off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** define a token once in `:root` and redefine it under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`; the page offers no theme switch.
donts: **Don't** load a web font, add letter-spacing to UI text, or set anything in uppercase; the system sans and mono are the type.
**Don't** use blue for anything but the Run fill, focus, selection and the winning row; never as a heading, link, border or background.
**Don't** use red outside a fault or the Remove question action; no red emphasis, warning or decoration.
**Don't** draw a CSS border in the light or dark scheme; edges are hairline shadows, and borders belong to forced-colors mode only.
**Don't** give a block on the page an offset shadow, a gradient, an engraved legend, a glowing readout or any hardware metaphor.
**Don't** put a tooltip where a visible name belongs, and never name a control only by its tooltip.
**Don't** round, restyle or re-derive a returned value; show it as the API said it.
